=Extract every distinct product offer from this supplier email. This is a first-time sender with no known column layout, so read the raw content directly.

Subject: {{ $('Resolve Body Profile').all()[$itemIndex].json.subject }}
Sender: {{ $('Resolve Body Profile').all()[$itemIndex].json.fromAddress }}

Prose/context (may contain terms like Incoterm, warehouse, lead time, MOQ that apply to ALL offers below unless a line overrides them):
{{ $('Resolve Body Profile').all()[$itemIndex].json.prose }}

Raw content blocks:
{{ JSON.stringify($('Resolve Body Profile').all()[$itemIndex].json.blocks) }}

Return one entry per distinct product/price combination. Use these exact enum values where applicable:
- currency: EUR, USD, GBP, AED, SGD, Other
- unitType: Bottle, Can, Jar, Pack, Piece, Other
- priceType: Per Case, Per Bottle, Per Can, Per Piece, Per Pack, Per Jar
- bondStatus: Bonded, T1, T2, Duty Paid, On Floor, Other
- incoterm: EXW, FCA, FOB, CFR, CIF, DAP, DDP, Other
- category: Beer, Spirits, Champagne, Grocery, Confectionery, Toiletries, Soft Drinks, Other FMCG

If a field is genuinely not stated anywhere, leave it blank/null rather than guessing. Never invent a price or product name.
